title: Crispy Uni Skewers with Slovakian Spices
description: A unique twist on traditional Mexican skewers, these Crispy Uni Skewers blend the freshness of uni with the bold flavors of Slovakian spices. Perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: Thread uni onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together Slovakian Paprika, cumin, lime juice, and garlic.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the uni.
Place skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the uni is cooked through.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with crispy tortilla strips.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
